Single performance tweak: 32x32 tiles.", "plan": "Edit kernel to 2D block load/store with tl.trans. Update run to 2D grid. Preserve dtype, contiguity, immutability. No torch compute. One localized perf change: tile size 32.", "base_sha256": "af3395c5c961163afa39607982ca165721ebf6fe68e7b475bf5e982f95e33719", "edits": [{"before_lines": ["@triton.jit", "def transpose_kernel(x_ptr, out_ptr, M, N, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):", "    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)", "    offs = pid * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)", "    out_mask = offs < (M * N)", "    i = offs // M", "    j = offs % M", "    src_flat = j * N + i", "    x = tl.load(x_ptr + src_flat, mask=out_mask, other=0.0)", "    tl.store(out_ptr + offs, x, mask=out_mask)"], "after_lines": ["@triton.jit", "def transpose_kernel(x_ptr, out_ptr, M, N, BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr):", "    pid_m = tl.program_id(axis=0)", "    pid_n = tl.program_id(axis=1)", "    offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)", "    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)", "    mask_m = offs_m < M", "    mask_n = offs_n < N", "    mask_2d = mask_m[:, None] & mask_n[None, :]", "    x = tl.load(x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * N + offs_n[None, :], mask=mask_2d, other=0.0)", "    x_t = tl.trans(x)", "    tl.store(out_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * M + offs_m[None, :], x_t, mask=mask_n[:, None] & mask_m[None, :])"]}, {"before_lines": ["    BLOCK = 32", "    grid = (triton.cdiv(M * N, BLOCK),)", "    transpose_kernel[grid](x, out, M, N, BLOCK=BLOCK)"], "after_lines": ["    BLOCK_M = 32", "    BLOCK_N = 32", "    grid = (triton.cdiv(M, BLOCK_M), triton.cdiv(N, BLOCK_N))", "    transpose_kernel[grid](x, out, M, N, BLOCK_M=BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N=BLOCK_N)"]}, {"before_lines": ["    assert x.is_cuda and x.dim() == 2"], "after_lines": ["    assert x.is_cuda and x.dim() == 2 and x.is_contiguous()"]}, {"before_lines": ["    out = torch.empty((N, M), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)"], "after_lines": ["    out = torch.empty((N, M), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)"]}] }
